item: The last two unprefixed ThreadPoolExecutor pools in src/ carry a thread_name_prefix and the pin requires one on every pool
summary: src/llm/concurrency.py run_concurrent's pool is now oo-llmbatch and src/ingest/segmented_download.py segmented_fetch's pool is oo-segfetch (R324); tests/test_threads_are_named.py requires every ThreadPoolExecutor in src/ to pass thread_name_prefix (red first on exactly those two) and replaces the two-file list that #1578 pinned. open_stats.thread_family files their workers under oo-llmbatch and oo-segfetch instead of ThreadPoolExecutor; the llm batch workers run the caller's function (langdetect, the coordinator, perception extract), so any store open one makes is now attributed to oo-llmbatch, which is the point; the segmented fetch workers fetch bytes and open no store. tests/test_open_stats.py's existing scan of every oo- name still passes. Not measured: how many store opens the llm batch workers make on a real run.
